item.title: Enron: A Look Back
item.description: Enron did not collapse because of a few bad actors. It collapsed because an entire ecosystem of supposedly intelligent, well-paid professionals chose not to see what was in front of them.

item.title: The Smartest Guys in the Room: The Amazing Rise and Scandalous Fall of Enron
item.description: The definitive account of Enron's collapse. A story of arrogance, fraud, and a culture where looking smart mattered more than being honest.
